what: the corpus lane's list of the read words at the 28 places written one way and read another whose read form holds two or three words: for each of the 57 read words, the place's own word number, its main tag as TAHOT writes it and its pieces as TAHOT gives them (relay v192 as amended by relay v192.1: the word place on every line, and at Psalms 10:10 the edition's letters on the piece TAHOT spells otherwise); beside it the lane's two facts for the stroke at each of the 16 places of relay v179; and the amendment's one-line list of the tag a lattice piece lost (Genesis 14:17, where TAHOT writes its mark inside the word). Kept here byte for byte in the folders the lane keeps them in, with their rules, their receipts and the counts. tools/apply-read-words-v1.mjs writes each read word's tag on its own region of the zone and, at the places the lattice gives no pieces, the pieces, and at a lost tag's place TAHOT's words on the piece; tools/project-lattice-v12-v1.mjs reads a lost tag as the lattice piece's own; the reader asks each read word its own entry and draws the place's line from the pieces. The stroke facts write nothing: they are held equal to the list data/paseq-place/PIN.json names, which the zones already carry

amends.says: the list of relay v192, which the amendment's own receipt names as the list it read; it is not kept in this tree

lost_tags.says: one line for each TAHOT row whose Hebrew goes on after its first backslash and that no read word reads: the lattice piece that lost TAHOT's tag and English, as it stands and as it is set

amendment.says: it amends the rule of relay v192 in three points and changes nothing else: a word place on every line, the edition's letters at Psalms 10:10, and the lost tag

holds_lifted.why: the amended line's piece carries the edition's letters, TAHOT's spelling beside them, so the place's pieces spell its read words; its two tags land with its pieces

lifted_by: the lane's next lattice, which carries each read word's pieces and tags on the read-form entry itself (RULE.md, section 8). The tool refuses a zone projected from another lattice than the one the lane's receipt read, and this pin is retired then
note: every sha256 here is the one the relay's letter names for the file, and the lane's receipt names the two lists, the counts and the rule by the same. The lane's folder also holds its builder, its second count and that count's receipt; the second count found the 28 places from the lattice's surfaces alone and agreed on all 57 lines and all 16 stroke lines. Those files are not kept here. Which places are held back, and what of each (its pieces, or, where the entry holds «tags and pieces», the place whole), is the page lane's decision, set here as data so neither the tool nor the check names a place in its code: at a place held whole the tool writes no tag and no piece and refuses a zone that carries either, and the check holds the place to carry neither. The readings named here are the two the landing plan of 14 November 2026 names for this list (its section 4.2), each written as the list gives the read word's pieces, a slash between them: the tool refuses a pin that names a reading the list does not give, and the check holds the page's line to each, so no check names a place in its code either
